Durable rules:
- TWO .claude/ dirs exist: ./.claude/ (working ON the meta-system) and ./template/.claude/ (gets installed INTO target projects). Never conflate.
- Template files use .template suffix. Don't edit them as live config.
- Non-destructive install: code that touches a target project's .claude/ must merge, never overwrite.
- Scripts for mechanical work (renaming, indexing, validation). Not every task is an AI task.
- Plan before structural changes. This project is the foundation other projects inherit.
- Verify file existence before recommending a path or command.
